column2: A New York subway commuter in January: a buttoned navy winter puffer coat, a wool scarf, a knit hat perched on the petals, a messenger bag across the chest, a formal shirt collar, and no trousers: plain grey boxer shorts, bare legs, black dress socks and leather office shoes, holding a folded newspaper, standing calmly as if nothing is wrong.

A New York subway commuter in January: a buttoned black puffer coat, a scarf, and aggressively ordinary khaki trousers with a belt, brown shoes, holding a paper shopping bag low in one hand, a slightly awkward posture, as if everyone else missed an email.

A subway showtime dancer: a lean athletic performer in a red tracksuit jacket, black basketball shorts over leggings, fresh white high top sneakers, a flat brim cap turned backwards perched on the petals, one arm raised as if gripping a pole, the free palm open marking a beat, feet planted.

A Grand Central commuter frozen mid stride: a long camel wool overcoat, grey suit trousers, polished office shoes, a leather briefcase in one hand, the other hand holding a paper coffee cup tilted as if about to spill, torso tipped forward, one heel lifted but both feet supported on the ground.

An off duty Santa: a cheap red velvet Santa suit with white fur trim, a black plastic belt with a gold buckle, slipping black boot covers over sneakers, a white beard fastened below the flower petals, a red hat perched on the petals, one hand on the belt, the other holding a red plastic cup.

A Times Square street performer: a muscular man wearing only plain white briefs, tall white cowboy boots and a blank white cowboy hat perched on the flower petals, an unbranded acoustic guitar held at working height on a strap, a planted confident stance.

A Mandarin duck drake, photoreal: orange sail feathers on the back, an iridescent green and purple crest, a white eye stripe, orange whiskers, a red bill, standing on flat ground, the whole bird visible, three quarter view. This is a real duck with a real duck head, no flower.

A bronze statue of a pug dog lifting one hind leg to urinate, cast in dark patinated bronze with a greenish patina, standing on a small flat bronze base, photoreal metal, the whole figure, three quarter view. This is a dog with a dog head, no flower.

A bronze statue of a small girl standing defiantly with both hands on her hips and chin up, wearing a dress and sneakers, her head a giant flower with one eye cast in the same dark patinated bronze with a green patina, standing on a flat bronze base, photoreal metal, the whole figure, three quarter view.
